units.source_text: 人们议论，胜负大约一目上下。

en.t: People were saying that the margin of victory was probably around one point either way.

units.source_text: 如今白力争胜两目，黑也必须加强了。

en.t: Now White was striving hard to win by two points, so Black also had to strengthen its position.

units.source_text: 大竹七段扭动着身子，那张稚气的圆脸上头一次暴起了青筋，响起了急促的扇扇子的声音。

en.t: Otake 7-dan twisted his body, veins bulging for the first time on his childish round face, and the hurried sound of his fan fluttering rang out.
